The app takes no key that is held with ⌘, ⌥ or Ctrl, except ⌘, (Ctrl+, off the Mac) for Configuration and Ctrl with PgUp, PgDn, Home or End. The other keys go to the system, so the window-arranging keys of macOS and the desktop-switching keys of Linux work while the app is in front.

On a Mac, ⌘W and the red button close the window, and the app stays in the Dock and goes on checking sources and summarizing. Click the Dock icon to open the window again. ⌘Q quits.
